rules.reason: Being unable to swallow needs same-day assessment.
Sudden hearing loss needs prompt assessment.
Fever with throat or ear symptoms for three days or more.
Symptoms lasting five days or more.
The person rates the problem as severe.

source_notes: Rules are student-authored from the general principles in public triage guidance (NHS emergency advice, ESI handbook, WHO emergency triage). Source clause references still to be added; NOT clinically validated.
